notes.title: The English version is on the Way. Probably around the week.
notes.content:
We are excited to reveal some information about the English version of Aker Fern. The final tests are underway and the final should be reached next week with the update.

Regards Chaos Group Games.
Note translated from google translator

notes.title: A handful of information about the Upcoming: Aker Fern: The Szatris Core.
notes.content:
If, like us, you are looking forward to the premiere of our next production, we have something that may interest you.
You will learn about the planned premiere and upcoming news.


For people who do not know the Polish language.

Suggestion for Aker Fern:
- Planned premiere of the translation of the first part of the game into English.

A suggestion for Aker Fern: The Szatris Core.
- Planned premiere in two languages, Polish and English.
- New characters will appear.
- The length of the game is comparable to the previous part.
- Polish Voice Acting.
- A whole new story related as with replies to the first part.
- Extensive animations enriched with sound effects.
- Histroria focused on solving mysteries with a hint of comedy.
- First there will be a Demo version containing the first chapter.
- Characters and backgrounds have been refreshed Graphical.
 

In order to translate the text, google translator was used for which we apologize.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=V8a5h3rLWxQ

notes.title: Are you ready for Aker Fern 2
notes.content:
We are pleased to officially announce and invite you back to the crazy world known from the first game. What awaits you ... check for yourself:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=gS3KXzrl5Ug
We wonder if you are as excited as we are at the thought of meeting again;)
Write how do you remember your first visit to this crazy school and what surprised you the most about it?
